annotations.title: Read a screen from the catalogue

description: Read one screen as Markdown: what it's for, two or three layouts with when to pick each, the Candor UI items that build each (with tiers), an install command, the honesty rules that matter most on it, and a brief to hand to the coding agent that builds it.

slug.description: The screen's slug, as list_screens or suggest_components gives it, e.g. "approvals-inbox".

version.description: A release, e.g. "2.6.2": the page as that release published it, for a project that has that version installed. Default: the version the server's URL passes (`?kit=`, which `npx candor-ui mcp` writes from candor-lock.json), else the current docs. When that release's docs weren't kept, or the page isn't in them, the answer is the current page with a note saying so.

name: get_screen
